raw.cause: camera answered five frame requests, then on the sixth (camera_frames > 5, COCKPIT_FAULT=camera-hang) camera_handle wedged in pause() after MsgReceive and never called MsgReply. display's main loop calls MsgSend to camera inline with no isolation, so its only thread stays REPLY-blocked forever and never reaches nav or logger again. A send timeout would not help: the name_attach() channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, so the client stays blocked until the wedged camera handles the unblock pulse, which it never does.
raw.qnx_call: MsgReply missing in camera (camera_handle hangs); synchronous MsgSend to camera in display's main thread
raw.fix_summary: Take the camera MsgSend out of display's drawing loop. A dedicated camera_reader thread does the MsgSend and stores the last frame; the loop only reads that frame under the mutex and shows 'camera stale' when it is old. Make that the unconditional behaviour, not something enabled by COCKPIT_FIXED. Separately fix camera's grabber so it always replies, or calls MsgError on failure.

finding: camera stopped answering and took display down with it
